mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat (message, user_id, timestamp) VALUES (#{message}, #{user_id}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT message, user_id, timestamp FROM chat ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT rm.room_no, rm.user_id, i.item_name, i.item_price, i.item_image, f.item_file_name FROM roomMember rm JOIN room r ON rm.room_no = r.room_no JOIN item i ON r.item_no = i.item_no LEFT JOIN item_file f ON i.item_no = f.item_no WHERE rm.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.*, rM.*, u.*, i.*, ifile.* FROM room r JOIN roomMember rM ON r.room_no = rM.room_no JOIN users u ON rM.user_id = u.user_id JOIN item i ON i.item_no = r.item_no JOIN item_file ifile ON ifile.item_no = r.item_no WHERE r.room_no = #{room_no};
